handoffs.message: EVO-004 implementation complete. Three gaps closed: (1) POST /api/evolution/proposals/{id}/rollback-followthrough — dedicated rollback follow-through endpoint with freeze_mode=rollback fixed; (2) POST /api/evolution/proposals/{id}/redeploy-followthrough — exposes controller.create_redeploy_followthrough() as HTTP endpoint with DispatchCommandResponse; (3) GET /api/evolution/action-paths — machine-readable routing matrix documenting owner/threshold/cooldown for all 4 action families (freeze, rollback, retrain, redeploy) per EVOLUTION_REVIEW_AND_THRESHOLDS.md §11.1. 8 new tests added: cooldown enforcement (2), action-paths endpoint (2), redeploy followthrough (2), rollback followthrough (2). All 47 tests pass. Please review against acceptance criteria: freeze/rollback/retrain/redeploy each have endpoints with documented owner/threshold/cooldown; cooldown enforcement tests pass.
Auto-reassigned review from Gemini to Codex after repeated Gemini capacity/429: Capacity / rate limit failure

Review blocked: redeploy-followthrough accepts executed freeze decisions, rollback-followthrough allows no-runtime/no-binding execution, and action-paths diverges from boundary_for. See .coordination/reviews/DEPTH-EVO004-review.md.

All 3 Codex review findings resolved. (1) freeze_paper_canary → freeze_non_live, freeze_live_no_runtime → freeze_live_no_active_runtime — path keys now match boundary_for() output exactly. (2) retrain_revalidate split into research_retrain + research_revalidate matching research_{action.value} convention. (3) Existing rollback test updated with active_binding_id; 3 regression tests added covering each finding. Commit: 3ef4bbe. 50/50 tests pass.
Review approved: action-path naming, rollback binding guard, and regression coverage verified; owner should finalize to done when ready.
